verdict.rationale: Per-call machine payments are a fair question for an agentic-commerce payments platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only documents cart, checkout and order flows for merchants selling goods. Those flows require buyer-reviewed checkout completion and handoff to a checkout UI. Nothing documents HTTP 402 responses or a way for a developer to charge agents per API call. AP2 payment mandates are an adjacent payment-authorization feature, not this capability.
